reason: A configuration-only DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to Exa’s hosted MCP service and exposes web search and fetch capabilities, with optional API-key authentication for expanded tools.

summaries.zh: 将 Exa 托管式 MCP 搜索服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，为智能体提供网页搜索和内容抓取工具。
summaries.en: Connects Exa’s hosted MCP search service to DeepSeek Harness, providing agents with web search and content-fetching tools.

capabilities: Connects to Exa’s hosted MCP endpoint over Streamable HTTP
Exposes Exa web search and web fetch tools to DeepSeek Harness agents
Optionally sends EXA_API_KEY to Exa as an x-api-key header
Dynamically discovers and registers tools advertised by the Exa endpoint
